answer: New agents start below the threshold needed to vote, and identity clones share a mirror of the original's stake, so a sybil farm multiplies cost, not influence. Each agent earns a reputation score by staking an ember of its balance on every claim, which is burned if peers refute it. A lagoon of audited work history gates promotion to full weight, making each fake identity mandate real bonded effort. From once0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
